data.title: 红莲 · 晴空草甸的十指相扣
data.description: 微风吹拂的青草坡上，草帽放在一旁充当遮阳。两人并肩躺在盛开野花的绿茵中看白云流转，十指紧密相扣，雪白马尾在微风中轻抚你的手臂，岁月安好。
data.location: sunlit grassy meadow with blooming wildflowers
data.action: 两人并肩躺在盛开野花的绿茵中看白云流转，十指紧密相扣，雪白马尾在微风中轻抚你的手臂
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunlit day with gentle flower dappled light
data.promptProse: From above, silver-haired Scarlet lies at one end of the wildflower meadow with her broad straw hat set aside. The short-haired commander lies beside her in a tan shirt with the sleeves rolled up. Their fingers interlace on the grass where dappled sunlight breaks across the two arms.
